CustomField.description: Command Center logic, the why text on Coaching list rows: Dropped N pts, Commit not backed, Off track or Needs attention.
CustomField.formula: TRIM(IF(PH_CC_Dropped__c, "Dropped " & TEXT(ROUND(ABS(Close_Likelihood_Score__c - Prior_Health_Score__c) * 100, 0)) & " pts. ", "") & IF(PH_CC_Commit_Backing__c = "Not backed (under 70%)", "Commit not backed. ", "") & IF(CONTAINS(Health_Category__c, "Off Track"), "Off track.", IF(CONTAINS(Health_Category__c, "Needs Attention"), "Needs attention.", "")))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Command Center: why this deal is on the Coaching list.
CustomField.label: CC: Attention reason
